headline: Your new website is in the planning stage
message: Watch your new Business Plans Hawaii website go from kickoff to launch, one step at a time. Your current site stays exactly as it is until you approve the new one. I update this page at every step.

stages.title: Agreement and payment received
stages.note: One flat fee of $750, due on receipt, covers the full rebuild and the move to Framer. The short agreement spells out exactly what is included. Framer itself is about $10 a month, billed by Framer straight to you, and you own that account.

stages.title: Access to your site and domain
stages.note: I need access to your current site and to where your domain is managed, so I can copy your pages and, at launch, point the same web address to the new site. You can remove my access any time.

stages.title: Build in Framer
stages.note: I rebuild your site in Framer on your own account. The work takes about 5 business days from the day I have access and your go-ahead.

stages.title: Preview for your approval
stages.note: You get a private preview link and look it over: the words, the photos and the layout. Your live site is not touched, and nothing goes live without your OK.

stages.title: Launch on your domain
stages.note: After your OK, the new site goes live on your same web address, and I check the real site, not just the preview.

stages.title: Walkthrough
stages.note: We go through your new site together, live, so you know how everything works and how to ask for changes.
